opportunities.name: Purchase Request & Approval
opportunities.why: Every purchase passes from the requester to a manager, then to Finance when the amount is USD 1,000 or more, then to Procurement. The approval tiers are explicit rules, so routing can be automated.

evidence.quote: USD 1,000 - USD 5,000 Manager approval + Finance validation
Requests missing required information must not proceed to approval.

opportunities.name: Purchase Request Intake & Completeness Check
opportunities.why: Each request must carry five required fields before anyone approves it. Checking them by hand is repetitive and a rule-based check can do it at submission.

evidence.quote: Every purchase request must include: Requester, Department, Requested Item, Estimated Cost, and Business Justification.

opportunities.name: Vendor Selection & Order Follow-up
opportunities.why: After approval, Procurement selects a vendor, places the order, and follows it up with the requester. These handoffs repeat for every approved purchase.

evidence.quote: Procurement is responsible for vendor selection, purchase execution, and order follow-up.
